card.name: Agent-noun endings inside split words
card.fires_on: The ending piece of a longer agent or role noun such as -mer, -ator, -er, -zer or -acker, when the word is split into parts. It appears in general web text, such as film titles, narration labels and glossaries.

modes.description: The -er, -mer or -zer ending of a noun for a person or thing that does something.

card.writes: It suggests word-ending pieces that complete nouns and adjectives, such as 'ified' and 'able', but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a person or thing noun, such as narrator, astronomer or drummer, when the word has been split up.
